_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX 虚拟币存款 master 790:15998. checkTextContainerStyle=true because variant card surfaces (segmented selector pills + white network/address card + #9ca3af@0.08 panel surface) anchor from their labels. Currency-logo VECTOR fills (Tether T, USDC C, Tron, Ethereum, BNB) + check-icon vectors + copy-icon vectors + QR-code 132×132 vector are mass-waived via iconDeviations because their pixel-perfect SVG paths come from figma exports we haven't yet converted to react-native-svg components (tool-bandwidth physical reason, identical to button/account-card master precedents). Geometry + container styling still gated.
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships HarmonyOS Sans SC + PlusJakartaSans-* — same family alias contract as dialogs/buttons/cards/account-card masters.
_deviationsNote: Bulk MISSING waivers for inner VECTOR/GROUP/RECTANGLE/INSTANCE sub-nodes of icons that already have iconDeviations waivers on their parent FRAME — figma authors these inner paths as part of an SVG glyph composite, and impl renders them as a single react-native-svg <Svg> or placeholder (no per-path data-figma-id). Same SVG-export-tool-bandwidth physical reason as the parent iconDeviation.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Essentional, UI / Copy$
iconDeviations.reason: Copy-to-clipboard icon FRAME (13×13 containing 2 VECTORs drawing the dual-rectangle copy glyph). Impl ships a CopyMark react-native-svg placeholder. Pixel-perfect Linear/Copy SVG deferred. Approved 2026-05-28.

iconDeviations.name: ^QR Code$
iconDeviations.reason: QR-code 132×132 FRAME containing 2 large VECTOR paths (the QR mosaic + finder-pattern frame). Approved 2026-05-28.

_textMatchNote: Master is 390px wide; labels repeat across variants (e.g. '区块链网络' appears in 5 of 8 variants, '最小充值' / '充值确认' in 4). 60px center-distance keeps matches inside their owning variant cell (340px-wide variants stack vertically with 20px gap, so 60px is safely under the 80px row spacing).
